title: Joining Celestin's band
summary: Contest nights at the Bulls Club, then eight or nine years with Celestin; personnel and the split band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: During that time, they had bands playing out here at the Bulls Club at 8th and Ramport.
At the Elks are where the Elks are.
There were big lawn parties out there too, I guess.

There were big lawns on both sides. Yeah, right. It was a contest every Tuesday night between different groups. And I played with Sidney Desvins band first. And after about three or four months, I joined Celestan's band. And I remained with them for about eight or nine years. And then...
Who else was in Celestan's band at that time? At that time?
When I first joined Celestan's band, he heard Ernest Kelly playing trombone. Celestan was playing trumpet. A fellow named Abby Foster, not Abby Foster. bamboo
You were talking about Salistan's band, you say Abby Foster, Chinese, was the drummer.
Any other trumpet? He usually used a second trumpet. Do you remember?
Salistan, Guy Kelly, and Ernest Kelly playing trombone.
I never knew Ernest Kelly or anything about him, hardly.

Well, Ernest Kelly peculiarly enough, he was playing a rather modern style of trombone then. Originally, had they split up? They had split. I came after the split. After the split. Yeah. And he had Jeanette Salvant, she was Salvant then, she was playing piano. And Simon Marrera was playing the bass violin. I took John Marrera's place, the banjo player. And Simon Marrera was playing bass violin. And that's about all. The band, Salistan's band, the men changed for quite a few times and around in the beginning of the, in about 29 or 30, we started playing at the Buena Fest and the White House Hotels over in Biloxi.
